يصطدمن (form VIII)
# يَصْطَدِمْنَ (yaṣṭadimna) /jasˤ.tˤa.dim.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَدَمَ (iṣṭadama)
# يُصْطَدَمْنَ (yuṣṭadamna) /jusˤ.tˤa.dam.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَدَمَ (iṣṭadama)
